name: warm dusk
notes: The game reads this file (src/core/look.js): change a colour here and the whole game follows. Roles, not decoration: base = the world (0 ground, 1 its darker partner, 2 structures and rock, 3 paths); accent = the things that matter to the player (pickups, the goal), kept rare; danger = only things that hurt; player = the player; shadow = the dark end; light = the bright end; ink = text over the game. sky and light set the time of day (sunElevation in degrees above the horizon; fogAmount 0 = clear, 1 = thick). Only colors and light are required; the rest is worked out. Pick a ready-made one with  node tools/vibes/list.mjs , or start from a picture:  node tools/assets/palette-from.mjs <image>. Also used by restyle.mjs --palette and look.mjs --in-game.
